title: Akiyama Mizuki — Perfect Presentation!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: carino/carina

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Thank you all for waiting, MORE MORE JUMP! We ask that you start getting ready for the rehearsal.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you...! We will!

rows.Speaker: Airi, Shizuku & Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Assistant Director
rows.Line:
Okay, let's review what you'll be doing.
First, you'll be introducing this segment's title. Then...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I-I'm feeling really nervous all of a sudden.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, you and the manager both. Look over there.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Excuse me, do you have a moment...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I think they want to talk to the manager...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They probably noticed how nervous he was.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I had a feeling!
*Sigh*
That's so thoughtful of them...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know, right?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (We just met for the first time a second ago, but I'm having no trouble talking to Saki...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(She's so cheerful.
I can't help but smile while chatting with her!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (You can totally tell that she's Tsukasa's little sister.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, by the way, what's Tsukasa like at home?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hm? Tsukasa?
Probably the same as he is at school.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whenever he starts talking about shows and stuff, you can't get him to stop! And when he starts practicing, you can hear him all the way down in the living room!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, down in the living room?!
Haha! I guess that makes sense considering how big his voice is!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! But hearing him practicing motivates me to do my best during band practice!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So... Oh, right...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: He's just himself when he's at home.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I can tell!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, actually, Mizuki!
Mind if I ask you something too?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sure! What's up?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
How did you meet Tsukasa?
Just at school?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... I think we actually spoke for the first time during Kamiyama High's School Festival.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: He originally started out as an acquaintance of an acquaintance. I went to the same junior high as Rui Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And then I heard from Rui that he met someone interesting.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Really...?!
Then, Rui introduced you two during the School Festival?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, he basically did...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I saw him perform with a couple of other people the same year as me, like a friend's younger brother and his partner.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, and Li'l Bro's partner is a huge fan of Tsukasa's! He knows all these hilarious stories about him!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Really...?!
I didn't know he had fans at school!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: He does! He couldn't stop applauding Tsukasa for putting on such a magnificent performance as Romeo.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And I was cracking up the entire time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're talking about when he played Swordmaster Romeo, right? I watched him practice at home and I couldn't stop laughing either!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! I knew it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Still, that's great to hear.
It must be so much fun having a big brother like him.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It is! He's been such a huge source of encouragement and is always willing to lend me a hand.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wow...! Sounds like he really cares about you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
While we're on the subject...
Do you have any siblings, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I have a big sister!
She's living overseas right now to pursue her dream♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Overseas?! That's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. I feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, we've got customers!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, these will be your first ones♪
Wanna show them to their table?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay! I'll try doing exactly what you taught me!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Welcome to carino/carina!
Table for two?
